sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Kashmiri dark Green Meenakari CZ Square Bracelet Watch for Women
sourceNotes.rawContent: Dark, dramatic, and deeply beautiful — this bold Kashmiri bracelet watch features striking dark green meenakari square panels with sparkling CZ stone centres, flanking a classic gold-tone quartz dial. Triple gold chains lined with ghungroo bells on both ends create an elegant cascading effect. A unique and powerful ethnic statement piece for women who love standing out at weddings, festivals, and special celebrations.
